verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms a dedicated MetalRT engine that uses Metal 3.1 GPU features on Apple Silicon (M3 and later), with real benchmark comparisons showing competitive-but-mixed performance against an open-source alternative (uzu wins some benchmarks, MetalRT wins others plus adds STT/TTS). However, M1/M2 chips are not yet supported and fall back to llama.cpp, and there's no first-party doc page detailing the Metal/ARM optimization internals. missing for 10: official documentation of the Metal/ARM optimization architecture, broader Apple Silicon support (M1/M2), and independent benchmark confirmation beyond a single HN thread.
